{{Top|leg}}
A '''sandmouse''' was a small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] from [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] kept as pets.<ref name="ML">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref> The animals could also be found on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and were noted for their quiet demeanour.<ref name="SP">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref>
